item.title: I fled Maduro’s Venezuela. Here’s what U.S. academics get wrong about intervention.

item.description: French, Drama, and German among the degrees that could be cut.

item.title: U. Washington researcher wishes conservatives dead: ‘may there be tyler robinsons for you all’
item.description: The University of Washington is investigating researcher Mara Maughan for a comment wishing for more conservative assassinations. A spokesperson condemned violence and confirmed a review of the incident.

item.title: Trump has revoked 8,000 student visas so far
item.description: 8,000 fewer foreigners have valid student visas, thanks to the Trump administration.

item.title: ‘There’s a harm there’: Supreme Court appears to side with bans on men in women’s sports

item.title: U. California professor says institutional neutrality not feasible – and he has a point
item.description: Institutional neutrality is meaningless if it allows for promoting LGBT agenda.

item.title: U. Arkansas professor who praised Ayatollah Khomeini demands hearing over demotion
